name: House
description: Four-to-the-floor pulse, small rhythmic variations, repeated harmonic cells and timbral evolution.

name: Funk
description: Syncopation and interlocking parts. The bass and drums share the conversation rather than merely keeping time.

name: Ambient
description: Long envelopes, sparse events, sustained harmonic fields and changes that arrive gradually.

name: Folk
description: Memorable melodic phrases, direct harmonic grounding and variation through performance detail.
